detail.longDescription: This afternoon a couple of my CI/CD pipelines broke because a user deleted all their their public repositories from # Github . I suppose many people are starting to be fed up with all what's going on with big companies stealing our code to train their # LLMs , or maybe it's something else... who knows. It's not like we have a single reason to be discontent with Github / Microsoft. Anyway... I started reviewing all my projects to ensure that I mirror all my critical dependencies so I don't suffer the same problem again. # CICD # AI # GenerativeAI # SupplyChain
